title: Explicitly approved synthetic LPAC W0 request
$comment: This is the request shape, not authority to execute. Native admission also rejects duplicate keys, malformed UTF-8, non-canonical paths, reparse points, wrong owner/FileID/hash and previously consumed attempts. Raw stdin is at most 16384 bytes. No CLI, credentials, arbitrary argv, environment or network destination is accepted.

absoluteWindowsPath.$comment: Native code additionally checks normalization, each component, NTFS handles, owner, no reparse/ADS/hardlink and final path/FileID. Schema validation alone does not establish a safe path.
